summary: Repeated HTTP 500 errors are likely caused by an application/database schema mismatch.
suspected_root_cause: Application code expects a database column that is missing from the current schema.

evidence_items.title: Application raised missing column error
evidence_items.summary: The application log shows requests failing because the orders table does not include expected column customer_segment.
evidence_items.raw_excerpt: ERROR column orders.customer_segment does not exist

recommendations.title: Verify schema drift and prepare safe migration
recommendations.reason: The application and database schema appear to be out of sync.
steps: Check the latest applied migration version.
Compare expected application schema with the live database schema.
Preview the migration before requesting approval.

restore_steps: Stop writes to the affected table if data has been written to customer_segment.
Run the reverse migration after approval.
Verify application errors return to baseline.
limitations: Rollback may require manual review if customer_segment receives production data.

user_message: I found evidence that checkout-api and the database schema are out of sync.

next_actions.label: Review remediation
next_actions.description: Open the proposed schema remediation plan.
